canonical_identity_contract.numeric_precision: float32; signed zero canonicalized; NaN retained
canonical_identity_contract.missing_category: missing:; non-missing strings use value: prefix
canonical_identity_contract.numeric_missing_policy: Canonical base numeric NaN remains distinct from zero; deterministic engineered non-finite values follow existing engineer_features (zero).
canonical_identity_contract.included: ordered deterministic engineered model features; float32 numeric values; NFKC/strip/casefold categorical strings
canonical_identity_contract.excluded: labels, metadata, raw identifiers, fitted scaler, fitted category indices, clipping, learned representations

fuzzers_normal_root_cause.interpretation: Rows identical apart from the dataset record id are duplicate events with conflicting labels. Label correctness cannot be adjudicated from these vectors; conflicts are irreducible for the current deployable feature space.

ambiguity_policy_option.diagnostic_population: official train + test; hypothetical loss only
ambiguity_policy_option.scientific_caveat: Using test labels to define ambiguity exclusions changes the evaluation population; requires a declared test-aware curation protocol and separate original-population reporting.

population: Official train and official test combined, before target purging; diagnostics only, never used to select or tune a model.
